correctness.rationale: At rational points the gradient reduces to three cubic equations, yielding exactly P_t with t^7+k t^3-1=0. The exact Hessian determinant 4(4t^7-1)/t^2 and tangent-cone discriminant 4(1-4t^7)/t^2 classify nodes and branch rationality. The only degenerate case has nonzero cubic coefficient along its unique tangent (separately checked for q=3), yielding an ordinary cusp by formal completion of square. Cyclic-field arithmetic proves the cusp-parameter and zero-parameter counts. The packaged program verified key identities and all rational points for five small prime fields; infinite claims rest on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The motivating explicit plane-filling pencil is known through a rational smoothness criterion and an unresolved geometric smoothness conjecture. The theorem supplies a complete and field-uniform local geometry/arithmetic classification for all rational singularities, including rational branch splitting and an exact cusp-fiber locus. The sharp infinite family of seven simultaneous rational cusps in characteristic three exhibits geometry not captured by the source root test alone. These are natural inputs to study singular fibers and normalization; no global smoothness or irreducibility contribution is claimed.
